The '''Roh village''' was a settlement on the [[Tharak]] continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fyodos]]. It was the home of the [[Roh tribe]] led by [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Kalor (Fyodos)|Kalor]]. It was located fourteen [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the [[landing point]], and one hundred kilometers from the [[Tharak installation]].
